counting_rules.method: regex scanning of CREATE/DROP statements across all migration SQL files
counting_rules.limitation: raw declaration counts; does not account for cumulative drops, replacements, or renames without a local schema build
counting_rules.confidence: medium — creation counts are accurate, final live-object counts require local Supabase build

rls_policies.note: includes policies later dropped and replaced; final count requires cumulative analysis

functions_rpcs.note: includes CREATE OR REPLACE which may be redefinitions; unique function count requires signature analysis

triggers.note: includes triggers later dropped and recreated

indexes.note: includes indexes later dropped; also IF NOT EXISTS may indicate idempotent reruns
